subject: executor: fix the hang of parallel sort when resultChannel is full (#59658)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff under `pkg/executor/sortexec`. The change avoids blocking writes into `SortExec.Parallel.resultChannel` from spill helper goroutines by collecting/returning errors locally (instead of per-worker sends) and removes `closeSync` to reduce `Close()` deadlock risk; adds failpoint coverage for Issue59655. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; no remaining Blocker/High issues attributable to this commit remain unfixed there.
